technical.summary: Long-term trend structure is bullish but short-term momentum is severely oversold without confirmation signals, price is below key moving averages, and volume/accumulation metrics are negative—high risk of false bounce.

fundamental.summary: MET shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 54 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: modest congressional buying by junior members lacks conviction; market fear (40 score) presents contrarian opportunity but absence of news data and bearish AAII sentiment (41.8%) limit confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (244.8) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 54 days adds event risk but is not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term EMA/SMA bullish structure and supertrend alignment provide directional bias, with price near support (66.02) offering defined risk entry in a fear-driven market correction.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis), negative momentum confirmation (MACD bearish, CMF negative, OBV not rising), no volume support, zero fundamental conviction, and price below both EMA-9 and EMA-20 create high probability of false bounce rather than sustained recovery.
